1.text: Uwo munsi Debora na Baraki mwene Abinowamu bararirimba bati

2.text: “Abagaba barangaje imbere y'Abisirayeli,Kandi abantu bitanze babikunze,Nimubishimire Uwiteka.

3.text: Nimwumve mwa bami mwe,Mutege amatwi namwe batware.Ngiye kuririmbira Uwiteka,Ndaririmba ishimwe ry'Uwiteka Imana ya Isirayeli.

4.text: Uwiteka ubwo wavaga i Seyiri,Ugaturuka mu gihugu cya Edomu,Isi yahinze umushitsi, ijuru rirareta,N'ibicu bitonyanga amazi.

5.text: “Imisozi itengagurikira imbere y'Uwiteka,Na Sinayi na yo, imbere y'Uwiteka Imana ya Isirayeli.

6.text: “Mu gihe cya Shamugari mwene Anati,No mu gihe cya Yayeli,Ibihogere byarimo ubusa,Abagenzi bagendaga basesera mu tuyira tw'uruboko.

7.text: Abatware b'Abisirayeli bari baracitse intege,Kugeza ubwo njyewe Debora nahagurutse,Mpaguruka ndi umubyeyi w'Abisirayeli.

8.text: Bishakira imana nshya,Intambara ziherako zugariza amarembo yabo.Nta ngabo habe n'icumu byari bikiboneka,Mu ngabo inzovu enye z'Abisirayeli.

9.text: Umutima wanjye wishimire abatware b'Abisirayeli,Wishimire n'abantu bitanze babikunze,Nimuhimbaze Uwiteka!

10.text: Mwa bahetswe n'indogobe z'imyeru, mwe,Namwe abicariye ibisuna byiza cyane,Namwe abagenzi uko mugenda mu nzira, nimuririmbe.

11.text: Kure y'induru z'abarasana, aho bavoma amazi,Abe ari ho bazajya bavugira ibyo gukiranuka by'Uwiteka,N'ibyo gukiranuka ko ku ngoma ye muri Isirayeli.Nuko abantu b'Uwiteka bamanukana amahoro mu marembo.

12.text: Kanguka, kanguka Debora!Kanguka, kanguka himba indirimbo!Haguruka Baraki mwene Abinowamu,Ujyane abanyagano abari bakujyanye uri imbohe.

13.text: Abasigaye mu banyacyubahiro,N'abo muri rubanda baramanuka,Uwiteka amanurwa no kuntabara abakomeye.

14.text: Abefurayimu bari bashinze imizi muri Amaleki baraza,Bakurikirwa n'ingabo z'Ababenyamini hagati muri bo,Mu ba Makiri habonekamo abagaba,Kandi mu Bazebuluni havamo abajyana inkoni y'umutware w'ingabo.

15.text: Abatware b'intebe ba Isakari bari kumwe na Debora,Abandi ba Isakari bakurikira Baraki,Birukira mu gikombe bamusibaniraho,Ku migezi ya Rubeni bahagira inama zikomeye.

16.text: Icyakwicaje mu mikumbi y'intama,Gupfa kumva imyirongi y'abungeri ni iki?Ku migezi ya Rubeni ni ho bibūranyirije cyane,

17.text: N'Abanyagaleyadi bigumiye hakurya ya Yorodani.Ni iki cyatumye Abadani basigara mu mato?Abashēri na bo biyicariye mu mwaro,Bigumira mu bigobe by'inyanja.

18.text: Abazebuluni ni abantu bahaze amagara yabo,Ntibatinye gupfa.N'Abanafutali ni uko,bitanze mu rugamba rubahanamiye.

19.text: “Abami baraza bararwana,Abami b'i Kanāni barwanira i Tānaki ku migezi y'i Megido,Ariko nta kintu cy'urwunguko babonye.

20.text: Ijuru riratabara,Inyenyeri mu ngendo zazo zirwana na Sisera.

21.text: Umugezi Kishoni urabatembana rwose,Wa mugezi wa kera witwa Kishoni.Wa bugingo bwanjye we, wasiribanze abakomeye!

22.text: Nuko amafarashi atabaguza yambuka,Asimbukana imbaraga, ahama.

23.text: ‘Nimuvume Merozi’, ni ko marayika w'Uwiteka yavuze.‘Muvume abaturage baho cyane,Kuko batatabaye Uwiteka,Ntibatabaranye n'Uwiteka kurwanya abakomeye.’

24.text: “Yayeli ahabwe umugisha kurusha abandi bagore,Yayeli uwo ni we muka Heberi w'Umukeni,Kuruta abandi bagore baba mu mahema.

25.text: Yamusabye amazi amuha amata,Amuzanira ikivuguto mu njome ya gipfura.

26.text: Arambura ukuboko asingira urubambo,Arambura n'ukw'iburyo asingira inyundo y'abakozi,Arukubita Sisera arushimangira mu mutwe,Rutobora muri nyiramivumbi.

27.text: Aripfunya yikubita hasi agaramye,Nuko amugwa ku birenge,Aho yaguye ni ho yapfiriye.

28.text: “Nyina wa Sisera ahanga amaso mu idirishya,Ahanga amaso mu idirishya arira,Ati ‘Ni iki cyatumye igare rye ritinda kuza?Inziga z'amagare ye zitindishijwe n'iki?’

29.text: Abanyabwenge bo mu baja be b'icyubahiro baramusubiza,Nk'uko na we yibwiraga,

30.text: Bati ‘Ahari babonye iminyago ni yo bakigabana,Umugabo wese aragabana umukobwa cyangwa abakobwa babiri.Sisera aragabana umunyago w'imyenda y'amabara,Imyenda y'amabara idaraje,Idarajwe amabara impande zombi,Yo kukwambika mu ijosi.’

31.text: “Uwiteka, ababisha bawe barakarimbuka batyo,Ariko abagukunda babe nk'izuba rirashe ritangaje.”Nuko igihugu gihabwa ihumure imyaka mirongo ine.
